vulnerability_class: invalid-free (bad-free / free of non-heap pointer, CWE-590)

nodes.evidence: Source line 'frame->cframe = cframe;' confirmed at frame.c:824 in the vul image; the else-branch at 812-825 sets frame->avoid_cframe_free=true (copy=false). Runtime witness: the ASan bad-free freed address 0x7ffffb3fd85e lies 94 bytes inside the 1048576-byte region [0x7ffffb3fd800,0x7ffffb4fd800) that the aflpp driver (ExecuteFilesOnyByOne, aflpp_driver.c:176) malloc'ed for the raw input. That the freed pointer is an interior pointer into the driver input buffer proves frame->cframe was set to (aliases) the untrusted buffer, i.e. this node executed with copy=false.

Frame admission gate 'if (trailer[trailer_offset - 1] != 0xce)' confirmed at frame.c:811. Witnessed: on BOTH images the frame is admitted and decompression is attempted -- the fix image prints 'Decompression error. Error code: -10' and the vul image proceeds into frame_get_lazychunk and crashes. If the 0xce trailer check had failed, frame_from_cframe would return NULL and no decompress path (frame_decompress_chunk -> frame_get_lazychunk) would run. Reaching the sink stack therefore establishes this gate was passed.

get_coffset(frame, header_len, cbytes, nchunk, &offset) confirmed at frame.c:1907. Reaching the in-memory materialization at 2021 (below) requires get_coffset to have returned rc>=0 with offset>=0 (otherwise the rc<0 early-return or the offset<0 frame_special_chunk goto would divert), so this node is control-dominated by the observed sink. Marked deferred rather than verified=true because directly witnessing this exact line's execution / the concrete offset value needs a coverage or DFSan rebuild (slow under qemu emulation); reason='line coverage needs a rebuild; run on native amd64'.

'*chunk = frame->cframe + header_len + offset;' confirmed at frame.c:2021 (the frame->cframe != NULL / in-memory branch). Runtime witness: the pointer passed to free() at the sink (2036) is exactly this *chunk value, and ASan reports it as an interior pointer 94 bytes inside the driver's input buffer -- i.e. *chunk = frame->cframe(=input buffer) + header_len + offset was computed and left with *needs_free==false. This branch (not the malloc'ing frame->cframe==NULL branch) is confirmed by the bad-free being on a NON-malloc'ed interior pointer.

Buggy guard 'if (needs_free) {' confirmed at frame.c:2035 in the vul image; the patch changes exactly this line to 'if (*needs_free)'. Patch differential: same 138-byte PoC on n132/arvo:31705-vul -> ASan bad-free at free(*chunk); on n132/arvo:31705-fix -> exit 0 with 'Decompression error. Error code: -10' (the rc<0 cleanup path is still entered but the corrected '*needs_free'==false guard now skips free). vul_crashes=true AND fix_clean=true => this guard is the root cause. 'needs_free' is a bool* (always a non-NULL stack address), so 'if (needs_free)' is always true and frees the never-malloc'ed *chunk.

'free(*chunk);' at frame.c:2036:7 IS the ASan crash line: '==7==ERROR: AddressSanitizer: attempting free on address which was not malloc()-ed: 0x7ffffb3fd85e ... #1 frame_get_lazychunk /src/c-blosc2/blosc/frame.c:2036:7', SCARINESS 40 (bad-free), DEDUP_TOKEN free--frame_get_lazychunk--frame_decompress_chunk. Directly observed on the vul image.

edges.via: frame->cframe aliases the input buffer; *chunk = frame->cframe + header_len + offset
edges.evidence: The freed *chunk is an interior pointer into the same driver-malloc'ed input region that frame->cframe points at (freed addr 94 bytes inside the 1048576-byte aflpp input region), proving the value flowed source->materialization.

edges.via: *chunk carried to free() on the rc<0 cleanup path
edges.evidence: The exact non-heap interior pointer materialized at 2021 is the operand ASan reports at the free() in 2036.

edges.via: always-true guard on the bool* address gates the free
edges.evidence: Correcting the guard to 'if (*needs_free)' (fix image) makes the same input exit cleanly (no free); the buggy guard being always-true is what lets control reach free(*chunk).
Data dependence offset->*chunk is structurally certain but the concrete tainted value flow needs a DFSan/coverage rebuild to witness directly; deferred under qemu emulation (run on native amd64).
ASan crash stack: #3 blosc2_schunk_decompress_chunk schunk.c:804 -> #2 frame_decompress_chunk frame.c:2761 -> #1 frame_get_lazychunk frame.c:2036.
frame_decompress_chunk calls frame_get_lazychunk (frame.c:2761 'rc = frame_get_lazychunk(...)'), which crashes at free(*chunk) frame.c:2036; consecutive in the observed backtrace.

root_cause_criterion.note: Guard defect (CWE-590 invalid-free). The buggy code tests the bool* address 'if (needs_free)' (always true) instead of its value 'if (*needs_free)'; on the rc<0 cleanup path this frees *chunk, an interior pointer into the in-memory frame buffer that was never malloc'ed. The patch's corrected guard 'if (*needs_free)' is the verbatim condition. Confirmed by patch differential: vul_crashes=true (bad-free at 2036) and fix_clean=true (exit 0, 'Decompression error. Error code: -10'); root_cause_confirmed=true.
